title_en: Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: Article 1 This Law is formulated for the purposes of promoting the healthy development of the socialist market economy, encouraging and protecting fair competition, preventing and stopping acts of unfair competition, and protecting the lawful rights and interests of business operators and consumers.

Article 2 In their production and business operations, business operators shall follow the principles of voluntariness, equality, fairness, and good faith, comply with laws and commercial ethics, and participate in market competition fairly.

For the purposes of this Law, "acts of unfair competition" means acts performed by business operators in their production and business operations that violate the provisions of this Law, disrupt the order of market competition, and harm the lawful rights and interests of other business operators or consumers.

For the purposes of this Law, "business operators" means natural persons, legal persons, and unincorporated organizations that engage in the production or sale of commodities or the provision of services (hereinafter commodities include services).

Article 3 The work against unfair competition shall adhere to the leadership of the Communist Party of China.

The State improves and perfects the rules and systems against unfair competition, strengthens law enforcement and judicature against unfair competition, maintains the order of market competition, and improves a unified, open, competitive, and orderly market system.

The State establishes and improves the fair competition review system, strengthens fair competition review in accordance with law, and ensures that all types of business operators shall equally use factors of production and participate in market competition fairly in accordance with law.

Article 4 People's governments at all levels shall adopt measures to prevent and stop acts of unfair competition, and create a favorable environment and conditions for fair competition.

The State Council establishes and improves a coordination mechanism for work against unfair competition to coordinate and handle major issues concerning the maintenance of market competition order.

Article 5 The departments performing market supervision and administration duties of the people's governments at or above the county level shall supervise and inspect acts of unfair competition; where laws and administrative regulations stipulate that other departments shall conduct supervision and inspection, those provisions shall apply.

Article 6 The State encourages, supports, and protects all organizations and individuals in conducting social supervision over acts of unfair competition.

State organs and their staff shall not support or cover up acts of unfair competition.

Trade associations shall strengthen industry self-discipline, guide and regulate business operators in their respective industries to compete according to law, and maintain the order of market competition.

Article 8 A business operator shall not, by offering property or other means, bribe any of the following entities or individuals in order to seek transaction opportunities or competitive advantages:
(1) staff members of the counterparty to the transaction;
(2) entities or individuals entrusted by the counterparty to the transaction to handle relevant matters;
(3) entities or individuals that may influence the transaction by using their authority or influence.
The entities and individuals specified in the preceding paragraph shall not accept bribes.
In business transactions, a business operator may, in an express manner, pay a discount to the counterparty to the transaction or pay a commission to an intermediary. Where a business operator pays a discount to the counterparty to the transaction or pays a commission to an intermediary, it shall truthfully record such payment in its accounts. The business operator that receives the discount or commission shall also truthfully record it in its accounts.
Where a staff member of a business operator offers a bribe, it shall be deemed an act of the business operator; however, this shall not apply if the business operator has evidence to prove that the staff member's act is unrelated to seeking transaction opportunities or competitive advantages for the business operator.

Article 9 A business operator shall not make false or misleading commercial promotions on the performance, function, quality, sales status, user evaluation, honors received, etc. of its commodities, so as to deceive or mislead consumers or other business operators.

A business operator shall not, by organizing bogus transactions, false evaluations or other means, assist other business operators in making false or misleading commercial promotions.

Article 12 A business operator shall not fabricate, disseminate, or instruct another person to fabricate or disseminate false or misleading information to damage the business reputation or commodity reputation of another business operator.

Article 14 A platform business operator shall not, by compulsory or disguised compulsory means, require a business operator within the platform to sell commodities at prices below cost according to its pricing rules, thereby disrupting the order of market competition.

Article 15 Large enterprises and other business operators shall not abuse their advantageous position in terms of capital, technology, transaction channels, industry influence, etc., to require small and medium-sized enterprises to accept clearly unreasonable transaction conditions such as payment periods, methods, conditions, and liability for breach of contract, or to delay payment for goods, projects, services, etc. owed to small and medium-sized enterprises.

Article 17 When the supervision and inspection departments investigate suspected acts of unfair competition, the business operator under investigation, interested parties, and other relevant entities and individuals shall truthfully provide relevant materials or information.

Article 18 Where a business operator is suspected of violating the provisions of this Law, the supervision and inspection department may hold an interview with its relevant responsible persons, requiring them to explain the situation and propose corrective measures.

Article 19 The supervision and inspection departments and their staff shall, in accordance with law, have the obligation to keep confidential the trade secrets, personal privacy, and personal information learned during the investigation process.

Article 20 For suspected acts of unfair competition, any entity or individual shall have the right to report to the supervision and inspection departments, and the supervision and inspection departments shall, after receiving the report, handle it in a timely manner in accordance with law.

The supervision and inspection departments shall disclose to the public the telephone numbers, mailboxes, or email addresses for receiving reports, and shall keep the reporters confidential. For a real-name report that provides relevant facts and evidence, the supervision and inspection department shall promptly inform the reporter of the handling results.

Article 21 A platform operator shall clearly stipulate the rules for fair competition within the platform in the platform service agreement and transaction rules, establish a reporting, complaint, and dispute resolution mechanism for unfair competition, and guide and regulate the operators within the platform to engage in fair competition according to law; where it discovers that an operator within the platform has engaged in unfair competition, it shall promptly take necessary handling measures according to law, preserve relevant records, and report to the supervision and inspection department of the people's government at or above the county level in the place where the platform operator is domiciled as required.

Article 22 Where an operator, in violation of this Law, causes damage to another person, it shall bear civil liability according to law.
Where the lawful rights and interests of an operator are harmed by an act of unfair competition, it may initiate a prosecution in the People's Court.
The amount of compensation for an operator harmed by an act of unfair competition shall be determined based on the actual losses suffered by it due to the infringement or the profits gained by the infringer through the infringement. Where an operator intentionally infringes upon a trade secret and the circumstances are serious, the amount of compensation may be determined at between one and five times the amount determined by the method specified above. The amount of compensation shall also include the reasonable expenses paid by the operator to stop the infringing act.
Where an operator violates Article 7 or Article 10 of this Law, and it is difficult to determine the actual losses suffered by the right holder due to the infringement or the profits gained by the infringer through the infringement, the People's Court shall, based on the circumstances of the infringement, award compensation of not more than five million yuan to the right holder.

Article 23 Where an operator, in violation of Article 7 of this Law, commits a confusing act or assists another person in committing a confusing act, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the illegal act and confiscate the illegal goods. Where the illegal business turnover is 50,000 yuan or more, a fine of not more than five times the illegal business turnover may also be imposed; where there is no illegal business turnover or the illegal business turnover is less than 50,000 yuan, a fine of not more than 250,000 yuan may also be imposed; where the circumstances are serious, the business license shall also be revoked.
Where a person sells the illegal goods specified in Article 7 of this Law, it shall be punished in accordance with the preceding paragraph; where the seller does not know that the goods it sells are illegal goods, and can prove that it has lawfully obtained the goods and disclose the provider, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the sale, without imposing an administrative penalty.
Where the registered name of an operator violates Article 7 of this Law, it shall promptly undergo a name change registration; before the name change, the registration authority shall replace its name with the uniform social credit code.

Article 24 Where a relevant entity, in violation of Article 8 of this Law, bribes another person or accepts a bribe, the supervision and inspection department shall confiscate the illegal gains and impose a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than one million yuan; where the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than one million yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed, and the business license may also be revoked.
Where the legal representative, principal responsible person, and directly responsible person of an operator bear personal responsibility for offering a bribe, or where a relevant individual accepts a bribe, the supervision and inspection department shall confiscate the illegal gains and impose a fine of not more than one million yuan.

Article 25 Where an operator, in violation of Article 9 of this Law, makes false or misleading commercial publicity about its goods, or assists other operators in making false or misleading commercial publicity by organizing fictitious transactions, false reviews, or other means, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the illegal act and impose a fine of not more than one million yuan; where the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than one million yuan but not more than two million yuan shall be imposed, and the business license may also be revoked.
Where an operator violates Article 9 of this Law and the act constitutes the publication of a false advertisement, it shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China.

Article 26 Where an operator or any other natural person, legal person, or unincorporated organization, in violation of Article 10 of this Law, infringes upon a trade secret, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the illegal act, confiscate the illegal gains, and impose a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than one million yuan; where the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than one million yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed.

Article 27 Where an operator, in violation of Article 11 of this Law, conducts a prize-giving sale, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the illegal act and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan.

Article 28 Where an operator, in violation of Article 12 of this Law, damages the business reputation or the reputation of the goods of another operator, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the illegal act, eliminate the adverse effects, and impose a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than one million yuan; where the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than one million yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed.

Article 29 Where an operator, in violation of paragraphs 2, 3, and 4 of Article 13 of this Law, uses the internet to engage in unfair competition, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the illegal act and impose a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than one million yuan; where the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than one million yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed.

Article 30 Where a platform operator, in violation of Article 14 of this Law, compels or covertly compels an operator within the platform to sell goods at a price below cost, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to cease the illegal act and impose a fine of not less than 50,000 yuan but not more than 500,000 yuan; where the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than two million yuan shall be imposed.

Article 31 Where an operator, in violation of Article 15 of this Law, abuses its dominant position, the supervision and inspection department of the people's government at or above the provincial level shall order it to make corrections within a specified time limit; if it fails to make corrections within the time limit, a fine of not more than one million yuan shall be imposed; where the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than one million yuan but not more than five million yuan shall be imposed.

Article 32 Where an operator that engages in unfair competition in violation of this Law falls under statutory circumstances such as proactively eliminating or mitigating the harmful consequences of the illegal act, the administrative penalty shall be mitigated or reduced according to law; where the illegal act is minor and has been promptly corrected without causing harmful consequences, no administrative penalty shall be imposed.

Article 33 Where an operator that engages in unfair competition in violation of this Law has been subject to an administrative penalty, the supervision and inspection department shall record it in the credit records and make it public in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.

Article 34 Where an operator violates the provisions of this Law and shall bear civil liability, administrative liability, and criminal liability, and its property is insufficient to pay all of them, such property shall first be used to satisfy the civil liability.

Article 35 Where a person obstructs the supervision and inspection department from performing its duties in accordance with this Law, or refuses or hinders an investigation, the supervision and inspection department shall order it to make corrections, and may impose a fine of not more than 10,000 yuan on an individual and a fine of not more than 100,000 yuan on an entity.

Article 36 Where a party is dissatisfied with a decision made by the supervision and inspection department, it may apply for administrative reconsideration or initiate an administrative action in accordance with law.

Article 37 Where a staff member of a supervision and inspection department abuses his power, neglects his duty, engages in malpractice for personal gain, or discloses a trade secret, personal privacy, or personal information learned of during an investigation, he shall be given a sanction according to law.

Article 38 Where a violation of this Law constitutes an act violating public security administration, a public security administration penalty shall be imposed according to law; where it constitutes a crime, criminal liability shall be investigated according to law.

Article 40 Where an act of unfair competition specified in this Law is committed outside the territory of the People's Republic of China, disrupts the domestic market competition order, or harms the lawful rights and interests of domestic operators or consumers, it shall be dealt with in accordance with this Law and relevant laws.
Article 41 This Law shall come into force on October 15, 2025.
